entities.name: Alojz Tkáč
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Monsignor Alojz Tkáč was a Slovak Roman Catholic prelate. He was the bishop of Košice from 1990 to 1995, the first archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Košice from 1995 to 2010 and archbishop emeritus until his death.
